issues.description: getCategoryLabel heuristic silently regresses labels that the prior explicit map handled correctly.
issues.detail: All six reviewers flagged this. The deleted CATEGORY_LABELS table guaranteed canonical labels (e.g. 'trustboundaries' -> 'Trust Boundaries', 'forensics-ready' -> 'Forensics Ready'). The new length<=3 / regex heuristic produces 'Trustboundaries' and will mislabel future 4-letter acronyms (SAML, OIDC). Restore the explicit table as source of truth; use heuristics only as fallback for unknown ids.

issues.description: SEVERITY_ORDER adds duplicate ordinal by aliasing Info and Informational to 4, breaking the bijection invariant.
issues.detail: Five reviewers flagged this. Two keys now map to rank 4, breaking any reverse-lookup, sort, or grouping that assumed uniqueness. The right fix is upstream: normalize 'Info' -> 'Informational' at the API boundary so the shared constant remains a clean bijection rather than carrying two names for one fact.

issues.description: CategorySelector sentinel handling conflates empty string and 'all' with the value domain.
issues.detail: Four reviewers flagged this. handleValueChange treats both '' and 'all' as null-clear, but Select only emits 'all' or a real id, making the empty branch dead code with no stated precondition. Additionally, 'all' collides with the category id namespace. Use one explicitly-named sentinel constant and document the precondition.

issues.description: HorizontalBarChart recomputes maxValue inside the per-row map, making it loop-invariant work.
issues.detail: Five reviewers flagged this. Math.max(...data.map(...)) is evaluated on every iteration although it is constant across rows. Hoist maxValue (and total) above the .map, making the invariant explicit and the render linear. The previous code had the same shape; fix while touching these lines.

issues.description: Removing category__in from DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES while adding the Category filter risks an orphaned active-filter badge.
issues.detail: Three reviewers flagged this. The PR introduces a Category filter on findings yet deletes its DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES entry with no stated replacement. Either confirm a generic path renders the badge (and document the invariant linking filter registration to badge rendering) or restore the entry; add a test.

issues.description: HorizontalBarChart overloads item.percentage with two distinct semantics (bar width vs share of total).
issues.detail: Two reviewers flagged this. calculatedWidth uses item.value/maxValue while displayPercentage uses item.value/total, both falling back from the same item.percentage field. The two quantities are semantically different. Split into named fields (widthRatio, sharePercent) or add a comment naming each invariant.

synthesis.summary: The panel reaches strong consensus that this PR is NEEDS-WORK rather than blocking. The dominant concern, flagged unanimously, is the replacement of an explicit CATEGORY_LABELS map with heuristic capitalization rules that silently regress known inputs ('trustboundaries' no longer becomes 'Trust Boundaries') and will mislabel future 4-letter acronyms. SEVERITY_ORDER's new Info/Informational alias breaks its bijection invariant and should be normalized at the API boundary instead. Smaller but real: CategorySelector's dual sentinel handling, HorizontalBarChart's loop-invariant max recomputation and overloaded percentage semantics, and a likely-orphaned category filter badge. Restore the explicit label table, normalize severity upstream, and tighten the smaller boundaries before merge.
